payload.title: Architectural Review: Alfred Operational Coordination Capability
payload.summary: The first Codex implementation package for Alfred's operational coordination capabilities has been merged into main, exercised locally, and successfully completed its implementation smoke test. I recommend that the remaining operational work packages begin using these capabilities to accelerate operational validation.
instructions: Review the current Alfred Routing Engine and Worker Inbox Watcher implementation.
Evaluate whether WP-0005 through WP-0010 should adopt Alfred routing as their default coordination mechanism.
Determine whether remaining work packages should be executed through the Collaboration Layer to generate operational validation evidence.
Provide architectural concurrence, recommended modifications, or objections.
observations: The routing engine successfully discovers message envelopes, validates them, applies routing rules, and generates worker inbox summaries.
The capability is considered Implemented and Operational Validation Pending.
The first local smoke test completed successfully without architectural changes.
Using Alfred routing for future work packages will simultaneously advance implementation and operational validation.
recommendations: Use Alfred routing for WP-0005 through WP-0010 wherever practical.
Treat each routed work package as an operational validation event.
Continue measuring reduction in Steward-mediated communication as the primary success metric.
